description: This file defines an authentication context provider (`AuthProvider`) for a React frontend application, managing user authentication state, token persistence to localStorage, and exposing login, register, and logout methods via context. It also exports a hook (`useAuth`) for consuming the auth state.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication context to its children, managing auth state and local storage persistence.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom React hook to consume authentication context, providing access to auth state and actions.
